NO_SILENT_OVERWRITE_NOT_ATOMICALLY_ENFOR.finding: save_sealed_worker_result performs an existence check and later publishes with os.replace. This is a check-then-replace TOCTOU race: two concurrent writers can both observe an absent final path and the later os.replace can replace the first completed artifact.
NO_SILENT_OVERWRITE_NOT_ATOMICALLY_ENFOR.future_requirement: Use an atomic no-clobber publication primitive or an equivalent fail-closed single-writer lock and test the concurrency case explicitly.

PRODUCTION_PARENT_RESUME_INTEGRATION_NOT.finding: V16 scenarios A-C manually exercise scanner and sealing primitives but do not demonstrate the complete run_training_parent -> missing_specs -> run_job_specs -> on_result_success -> interruption -> restart -> reuse valid results -> execute missing jobs only -> finalization path.

memory_evidence_qualification.qualification: The reported MPS probe used a synthetic 64-root batch with the same total pair count distributed approximately evenly across roots. Therefore the measured approximately 3.12 GiB allocation is not established as the exact real worst-batch production peak.

watchdog_execution_time.finding: Streaming materially changes repeated cache-read behavior relative to V15, and no evidence currently demonstrates that the maximum production job completes within the existing watchdog.

test_evidence_status.disposition: Evidence qualification only; not independently a scientific implementation failure.
